Messages.Author: Darky
Messages.Body:
Hospital Food reads:

Unique Location.
Requires a ready anarch

Tap when an anarch announces a hunting action. If that action is
successful, the anarch gains an additional blood.

----
If I'm not mistaken, the tapping is obligatory whenever any anarch
announces a hunting action, even if it's not your anarch. Am I right?

Secondly, was this intended?

Thanks in advance,

Bram Vink

Messages.Author: hawk_the_demon
Messages.Body:
with the same logic Anarch Railroad 'must' be tapped when an anarch
needs intercept...
'Tap to give an Anarch +1 stealth for the current action'

I think this should be read as 'you may tap'
